changed_factor: addTemplate training source is a clone of the existing 0/255 official warped mask; object_mask remains the same warped mask
actual_features_policy: Record unchanged V11 exhaustive behavior, including lower counts and failures; never fabricate features
mask_warp: INTER_NEAREST, black border, unchanged affine/canvas/crop recipe

shared_padding.scope: complete union of both banks and all six objects, one common dimension
shared_padding.selection: minimum aligned per-axis dimensions satisfying every loaded layer before development decode
shared_padding.freeze_after_training_before_development: BANK_FREEZE.json and COMMON_PADDING_FREEZE.json, including source/bank/metadata/attempt/layer CSV hashes

timing_schedule: Same 64 timing flags in the already frozen obj8 frame_schedule.json, 8 per scene, all objects
same_arm_path_equality: full ordered fields and float32 score bits

timing.external_call: padding allocation/copy, matching, box conversion and NMS

zero_success_bank: Record training failure and stop the comparison as incomplete; never silently omit the object
failure_policy: Preserve failure and partial evidence; no silent truncation, object removal, budget changes or missing-frame negatives
default_promotion: No automatic promotion from development results
transitive_pin_policy: Freeze six preservation manifests, original RGB banks/config/metadata/all attempts and fixed pilot raw references before training. Expected training image and mask SHA/size are read from the frozen download manifest (not invented historical runner member attestations). Wrapper verifies training-only member bytes before and after training; no development image is opened by training.
native_exception_policy: Any cv::Exception in addTemplate is recorded as an unsuccessful attempt; continue remaining attempts for evidence, but any such exception marks whole comparison incomplete and forbids quality stages.
private_compilation_policy: Compile actual experiment-private 7 core and 16 MIPP Git blob bytes; adapter includes private frozen helper copy whose line2Dup.h resolves only through the private include path.
runtime_policy: Real build and stage wrappers pin compiler tools, explicit import libraries, actual two-TU GCC dependency files, recursively resolved non-system static PE imports and executable before/after. OS/API-set DLLs are named but not hashed; dynamic plugins/every OS resource are outside this local provenance claim.
